title: Buttweld Fittings
tagline: Precision Engineered Elbows, Tees, Reducers & Caps per ASME B16.9
shortDescription: Bhansali Metals manufactures precision seamless and welded buttweld pipe fittings in high nickel alloys, stainless steel, and duplex steel with full material traceability.
metaTitle: ASME B16.9 Buttweld Fittings Manufacturer Mumbai | Bhansali Metals
metaDescription: Precision buttweld elbows (45/90°), equal/reducing tees, concentric/eccentric reducers, and caps in Inconel, Hastelloy, Monel & SS from Bhansali Metals Mumbai.
sizeRange: 1/2" NB to 36" NB (DN15 to DN900; Sch 5S to Sch XXS)

subTypes.name: 90° Long & Short Radius Elbow
subTypes.description: Directional piping component for 90° line redirection. Long radius (1.5D) minimizes friction losses; short radius (1.0D) optimizes compact skid layouts.

subTypes.name: 45° Long Radius Elbow
subTypes.description: Directional fitting changing fluid line path by 45 degrees with smooth low-turbulence flow.

subTypes.name: Equal & Straight Tee
subTypes.description: T-shaped branch connection providing a 90-degree branch of the identical nominal pipe diameter.

subTypes.name: Reducing Tee
subTypes.description: Branch connection providing a stepped-down branch pipe diameter while maintaining full run flow.

subTypes.name: Concentric Reducer
subTypes.description: Cone-shaped transition between pipes of differing nominal sizes aligned along a common center line.

subTypes.name: Eccentric Reducer
subTypes.description: Asymmetric conical fitting maintaining a flat bottom or flat top, preventing air pocket accumulation in horizontal pump suction lines.

subTypes.name: Pipe End Cap
subTypes.description: Ellipsoidal protective end closure welded directly to the pipe terminus to permanently seal process lines.

subTypes.name: Lap Joint Stub End
subTypes.description: Flanged sleeve fitting paired with loose backing lap-joint flanges to ease bolt alignment in tight spaces.

manufacturingProcess: Hot mandrel pushing for seamless elbows, hydraulic cold press forming for tees and reducers, full solution annealing heat treatment, and precision CNC end beveling per ASME B16.25.
qualityInspection: Liquid Penetrant Examination (PT) of weld preps
Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement across extruded crotch zones
100% Dimensional Inspection against ASME B16.9 tolerances
